report.summary: 4 reviewed findings: 1 critical, 1 high, 2 medium. Prioritize enforcing in-place mutation contract (critical), then prove node set completeness (high), then audit undeclared paths and _walk callers (medium).
risks: Missing enforceable contract for confirm_task in-place mutation could cause silent data loss if implementation changes.
guard_measurement_match may reject valid results or miss invalid ones due to node set mismatch.
No OS-level isolation found; _paths_overlap warning may be ignored.
Callers of _walk may mishandle self-included parent tuple.
todos: Inspect confirm_task implementation and write test verifying in-place mutation.
Write test for guard_measurement_match with known selection and deferred links.
Search for OS-level isolation (worktree, container) in codebase.
Identify all callers of _walk and verify parent tuple handling.

items.title: Enforce in-place mutation contract for confirm_task
items.why_now: Critical fragility: if confirm_task implementation changes to return new dict, mutation is lost silently. Must lock contract now.

steps.do: Add unit test that calls confirm_task with a dict, then asserts the dict is mutated (e.g., a key added).
Add explicit docstring to confirm_task stating it mutates the dict in-place and that callers must rely on mutation.

items.assumption: confirm_task is defined in daedalus/spine/attempt.py. If not, adjust path.

items.title: Prove node set completeness in guard_measurement_match
items.why_now: High risk: guard_measurement_match may reject valid results or miss invalid ones due to node set mismatch. Must settle with test.

steps.do: Write integration test that creates a selection with known nodes, runs reach.analyse on a repo with weak edges, and asserts observed node set matches selection.
Write test that adds a node only via deferred link in markdown, runs reach.analyse, and checks if that node appears in selection.

items.assumption: reach.analyse and guard_measurement_match are in daedalus/mapping/reach.py and daedalus/lanes/checks.py respectively. If not, adjust paths.

items.title: Audit OS-level isolation for undeclared paths
items.why_now: Medium risk: _paths_overlap only checks declared paths; if no OS isolation, concurrent writes may conflict. Need to confirm or mitigate.

steps.do: Search codebase for worktree, container, or OS isolation mechanisms.
If no isolation found, add a guard in _paths_overlap to warn if undeclared paths are detected or add a note in docs.

items.assumption: _paths_overlap is in daedalus/mapping/switches.py. If not, adjust path.

items.title: Verify all callers of _walk handle self-included parent tuple
items.why_now: Medium risk: if any caller relies on parent tuple not including self, it may misbehave. Must audit callers.

steps.do: Identify all callers of _walk using grep and add tests for each to verify correct handling of parent tuple (including self).
Update docstring of _walk to explicitly state that the parent tuple includes the node itself.

items.assumption: _walk is defined in daedalus/mapping/switches.py. If not, adjust path.
